execution.preview_basis: sanitized metadata inventory plus release-branch schema/migration review

crm_field_map.rule: trim and collapse whitespace; ambiguous or empty names go to manual review

crm_field_map.source_signal: family, school, household, organization, or audience-type signal
crm_field_map.rule: family for parent/guardian/household/follower audience; school for school/organization leads; ambiguous goes to manual review
lowercase and trim for private matching; never print value
normalize privately to E.164 for matching; never print value

crm_field_map.source_signal: subscription_status, unsubscribe export, STOP, bounce, complaint, or suppression
crm_field_map.target: onetime.contacts.suppression_state and legacy audience consent/suppression fields
crm_field_map.rule: opt-out and suppression override active/subscribed signals until resolved

crm_field_map.source_signal: campaign_source, import file, or list provenance
crm_field_map.rule: use stable source codes and file digest references
candidate-only until canonical legacy export is selected

crm_field_map.source_signal: member, active legacy user, paid member, learner, guardian, or household signal

crm_field_map.rule: do not import message bodies; use counts, status signals, and hashed references only after approval

tagging_map.applies_to: Rabbi Scheller Followers.xlsx rows after dry-run identity validation
operator-selected canonical legacy CRM or pipeline export only
source rows with subscribed signal and no stronger suppression
explicit opt-out, unsubscribe, STOP, bounce/complaint, or manual suppression
candidate parent/guardian/learner groupings that are not deterministic
all OPS-13B preview rows until explicit import approval exists

existing_production_counts.reason: OPS-13A did not connect to the production database or print private records

deduplication_rules: Normalize email by trimming/lowercasing and use only private dry-run comparisons or hashes in reports.
Normalize phone with an E.164 parser and do not print normalized values.
Within one file, identical identity fingerprints are duplicate_input unless consent/suppression differs.
Across files, unsubscribe/suppression records attach to the identity first and block later subscribed/import-eligible rows.
Existing scoped contacts by email or phone win over new contacts; preview disposition is matched_existing_contact.
If one email maps to multiple phones or one phone maps to multiple emails, disposition is manual_review.
Never merge across BNA, One Time, provider, family legacy, or public content boundaries without an explicit cross-workspace link.
household_reconciliation_rules: Create a household candidate only when a guardian identity and learner/member signal can be grouped deterministically.
If the source only has a follower/contact row with no learner grouping, keep it as CRM contact/lead.
Guardian authority defaults to manual_review unless source explicitly identifies authority.
Learner rows require student-safe visibility, guardian consent status, and active/suspended/archive status before access operations.
Household conflicts block only dependent portal activation or learner-access tasks.

consent_suppression_precedence.signal: legal/manual do-not-contact, abuse suppression, complaint, hard bounce, or provider-level suppression
consent_suppression_precedence.result: suppressed; no activation, marketing, reminder, WhatsApp, Telegram, or helper outreach

consent_suppression_precedence.signal: explicit unsubscribe, STOP, opt-out, or unsubscribed export
consent_suppression_precedence.result: suppressed until a later explicit opt-in is recorded
no send on that channel; contact may remain in CRM as non-contactable

consent_suppression_precedence.signal: subscribed or opted-in source with no stronger suppression
consent_suppression_precedence.result: eligible for preview only; actual send still requires bounded canary approval
manual review or non-send CRM only

before_ops13b_any_write: Refresh live source, PR state, Railway identities, migration ledger, and backup state.
Confirm production backup freshness or create a new protected backup outside Git before any write.
Run legacy audience preview in dry_run mode first.
rollback_records: Use onetime.legacy_audience_rollback_records for approved import batches.
Record affected_record_counts only, never private row values.
Rollback must be forward-only after merge.
hard_stops: Unexpected source SHA, missing backup, schema not latest, unreviewed suppression conflicts, or any request to print private rows.
Any Buffer canary before an account is connected.
Any broad customer send, live Stripe charge, DNS/account change, or provider mutation outside exact canary budgets.
